out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: grab’n’go cooler (L) at 44F and grab’n’go cooler (R) at 44F (service area).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discontinued use of the grab’n’go cooler(L) and grab’n’go cooler(R) at service area. PIC contacted a technician during the inspection.
